In 5-dimensional [[geometry]], there are 31 [[uniform 5-polytope|uniform polytopes]] with B<sub>5</sub> symmetry. There are two regular forms, the [[5-orthoplex]], and [[5-cube]] with 10 and 32 vertices respectively. The [[5-demicube]] is added as an [[alternation (geometry)|alternation]] of the 5-cube.

They can be visualized as symmetric [[orthographic projection]]s in [[Coxeter plane]]s of the B<sub>5</sub> Coxeter group, and other subgroups.

== Graphs ==
Symmetric [[orthographic projection]]s of these 32 polytopes can be made in the B<sub>5</sub>, B<sub>4</sub>, B<sub>3</sub>, B<sub>2</sub>, A<sub>3</sub>, [[Coxeter plane]]s. A<sub>k</sub> has ''[k+1]'' symmetry, and B<sub>k</sub> has ''[2k]'' symmetry.

These 32 polytopes are each shown in these 5 symmetry planes, with vertices and edges drawn, and vertices colored by the number of overlapping vertices in each projective position.
